senses.gloss: गृष्टि॑ f. a cow which has had only one calf, young cow, RV. iv, 18, 10; AV.; Kauś.; MBh. &c.
(ifc. with names of other animals, Pāṇ. ii, 1, 65) any young female animal (e.g. वासिता-ग्˚; a young female elephant, MBh. xi, 642)
गृष्टि॑ m. for घृष्टि, a boar, L.
N. of a man, Uttarar. iv, 5/6 and 10/11.
गृष्ट्य्-आदि a Gaṇa of Pāṇ. iv, 1, 136.
गृष्टिका f. = ˚टि, a young cow, Hcat. i, 10, 89
N. of a plant, Suśr. iv, 9, 8.
